units.text: I matched customer records from CRM, webshop and invoicing system with fuzzy matching in Python. I removed 870 duplicates and made a unified customer register in 10 weeks.
Our team changed the monthly PDF reports to a Power BI dashboard in 8 weeks. Requests for extra numbers went down 40%.
I updated the intranet news page for staff every week. I collected photos and stories from different departments.
